surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions were found to be self-limiting and complementary enough to yield uniform, conformal, and pure ZrO2 thin films on polymer substrates at room temperature. The UV light was very effective to obtain the high-quality ZrO2 thin films with good adhesive strength on polymer substrates. The alkoxy groups of Zr[OC(CH3)3]4 adsorbed on substrates may be easily converted to hydroxyl groups by H2O with UV light.
